audit_metadata.component: TRUSTLINE Supervisor Agent Timing & Telemetry Subsystem

prior_claim_analysis.verdict: CONFIRMED: The reported 4.2 ms supervisor overhead was NOT an independent bottom-up measurement; it was derived by top-down subtraction (total_elapsed_ms - subagent_total_ms).

persistence_zero_ms_root_cause_analysis.root_cause_summary: Topological execution order inversion between assessment construction and persistence execution.
details: 1. In LangGraph StateGraph topology, final_synthesis_node executes prior to persistence_node (final_synthesis -> persistence).
2. In final_synthesis_node, WorkflowTimingBreakdown was instantiated reading durations.get("persistence", 0.0). Because persistence_node had not yet run, this read returned the default 0.0 ms.
3. When persistence_node executed subsequently, it passed assessment_dict to PersistenceService.save_final_assessment with persistence_time_ms = 0.0 already baked into the payload.

4. Although persistence_node timed its own execution and wrote durations["persistence"], it never patched the returned assessment_dict in state, nor did it update the persisted disk file or SQLite record.
remediation_applied: PersistenceService.save_final_assessment now measures disk and SQLite write time, updates assessment_dict["timing_breakdown"]["persistence_time_ms"] in-memory, and writes the updated payload to disk and database.
persistence_node updates assessment_dict["timing_breakdown"]["persistence_time_ms"] and returns the updated final_assessment into the workflow state.
WorkflowTimingBreakdown schema extended with measured_supervisor_overhead_ms to separately expose bottom-up measured node time versus top-down wall-clock subtraction.
